integrity: The proof is an analytical finite LP duality plus uniform strong law and central limit theorem. The numerical verifier is supplementary and does not certify any infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns independent uniform nodes on the circle, exact constant/first-harmonic quadrature, and the relative l-infinity box around uniform weights. Finite formula requires noncollinear nodes; strictly positive weights follow only when the specified tolerance is below one. The limit is distributional, not a finite-sample concentration estimate; historical priority and independent mathematical review remain open.
title: A sharp Rayleigh transition and finite chord test for almost-equal random circle quadrature
